newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Uniden Manila unit set for Oct start-up.
newsitem.headline: Uniden Manila unit set for Oct start-up.

text.p: The Philippine unit of Japanese telecommunications equipment maker Uniden Corp will start operations at its cellular phone component plant in October, Manila government officials said on Tuesday.

Uniden Philippines Inc's plant in Taguig, southern Manila, built at a cost of 209 million pesos, will export its entire expected annual output of 304,036 telephone units to the United States, Canada, Europe and Australia, the Board of Investments (BOI) said.
Parent Uniden Corp would be the distributor, it added.
